name: channel-memory-store-and-scoped-sessions
title: Channel Memory Store and Scoped Runtime Sessions
description: Design and implement server-owned channel/task memory and scoped runtime sessions so agents can share channel knowledge without polluting unrelated DM/channel/task context. Local FUSE/WinFsp projections are documented later work, not the first-slice source of truth.
creator: 张岩.ean
notes: Created from 2026-06-22 design discussion with @zy-ean. Prioritize server-owned Channel Memory Store and task/session scope control. FUSE/WinFsp is a later local projection, not the source of truth. Selective prompt/context injection by session scope is implemented for the first slice after storage/API semantics were added.

meta.storageDecision: server-owned metadata and small text in DB; large or binary content in object/blob storage
meta.projectionDecision: FUSE/macFUSE/WinFsp can expose local channel memory views after API semantics stabilize
